definitions.explanation: Studying or learning a subject on one's own, without a teacher or formal instruction.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{独習|どくしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{独習|どくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦フランス{語|ご}→フランス語：24509_furansugo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけた。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{教材|きょうざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独習|どくしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This textbook is suited for self-study, so even beginners can use it with confidence.

notes:
Composed of {独|どく} (alone, self) and {習|しゅう} (learn, study). Emphasizes learning without a teacher.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独習|どくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to learn through self-study
- {独習|どくしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧: suited for self-study
- {独習|どくしゅう}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: self-study book
- {独習|どくしゅう}⟦テキスト→テキスト：01469_tekisuto⟧: self-study textbook
- {独習|どくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to acquire through self-study

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独学|どくがく}→独学：09601_dokugaku⟧: self-teaching — very close synonym, slightly more common in conversation
- {独習|どくしゅう}: self-study — slightly more formal, often used in book titles
- ⟦{自習|じしゅう}→自習：04212_jishuu⟧: self-study — studying on one's own, often during a designated study period at school
- ⟦{予習|よしゅう}→予習：01748_yoshuu⟧: preparation — studying material before class
- ⟦{復習|ふくしゅう}→復習：01718_fukushuu⟧: review — going over material after class
